what: Cancel-route render handoff omits repo forwarding
scenario_or_breakage: With explicit REPO binding, cancel summaries can show ISSUE_URL=N/A or upsert to the gh default repo instead of the routed issue repo
suggested_fix: Add ${REPO:+--repo "$REPO"} to both design-route.sh cancel render invocations and pin/document it

what: Resume manual flag is specified without its required value
scenario_or_breakage: A bare --manual-requested on manual resume consumes the next flag as its value or fails under set -u, aborting resume env refresh
suggested_fix: Specify and pin _wdce_resume_args+=(--manual-requested true) when manual_gate_b is true
